planets.name: K2-199 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-199 with a 3.23-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-199 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-199. Its orbit and size follow Akana Murphy et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
